name: Horizon Kinetic
description: A turning shaft drawn as Create draws its kinetic parts without Flywheel's backend: a block entity renderer whose model helper is set up at the end of the level renderer's reload (LevelExtractor.allChanged), a Mixin plugin's client mixins, the client player's hands read each client tick and data keyed by its class (SynchedEntityData.Builder). A check of the Java mod bridge.
